## Contribution checklist

Tick each box (replace `[ ]` with `[x]`). A maintainer checks these before merging.

- [ ] FERPA and student privacy have been considered.
- [ ] No credentials, passwords, API keys, or access tokens are included.
- [ ] No real student data appears in examples or screenshots.
- [ ] Data handling is described in `dataHandling`.
- [ ] The author is credited in `author`.
- [ ] Tested in the environment listed in `runsOn` (and `lastTested` is updated).
